answer: Give each attestation weight equal to the attester's own history, and burn it when the agent it vouched for fails an audit. Draw attesters from a rotating pool, so a farm cannot line up friendly reviewers across epochs. Vouching for a clone therefore costs the voucher real standing, which makes fake references expensive on both sides. A sparrow can cross a bridge once; the plume left behind is the burned attestation, and the next vouching costs double.
